description: Create or edit an item category, brand or item group (kind=category|brand|group). Omit id to create (name required); pass id to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value. Names are unique per kind (per parent for categories). Categories nest under parentCategoryId (makeTopLevel=true un-nests; a category cannot move under its own subtree). Editing a group's salesTaxId or depositFeeAmount also moves the items still on the group's old value, as the app does; the preview counts them. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential. Put items into entries with set_item_classification.

id.description: The entry id (GUID) to edit; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

depositFeeAmount.description: Groups only: deposit fee amount (0 or more). On an update, items in the group still carrying the group's old fee move to the new one, as in the app.

makeTopLevel.description: Categories only: true moves the category to the top level (clears its parent).

name.description: Display name. Required when creating; unique per kind (per parent for categories).

parentCategoryId.description: Categories only: the parent category id (GUID) to nest under. Omit to keep the current parent (a new category is created at the top level).

salesTaxId.description: Groups only: sales tax rate id (GUID, see list_tax_rates). On an update, items in the group still carrying the group's old tax move to the new one, as in the app.

slug.description: Categories and brands: optional URL slug used by connected storefronts.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
